facts.business: Manipal Health Enterprises Limited operates a nationwide multispecialty hospital network providing outpatient, emergency, inpatient, tertiary and quaternary care with a focus on six complex specialties: cardiac sciences, oncology, neurosciences, gastro sciences, orthopaedics and renal sciences (CONGO-R).
